claims.claim: matched positional baseline cannot reconstruct sources
claims.basis: all complete-archive arms build on the same versioned source archive and record zero reconstruction error over every revision

claims.claim: split-agnostic aggregate latency describes held-out behaviour
claims.basis: held-out rows are reported separately; scaled policies are evaluated on the held-out split only

claims.claim: budget percentage is a physical storage budget
claims.basis: the estimated payload budget excludes directory, table and page overhead, which is reported as structural_overhead_bytes
only payload+directory against payload+directory comparisons are reported; margins are per comparison, never global

claims.claim: a lower-byte arm dominates a faster arm
claims.basis: 1256 dominance and 2237 trade-off relations were found; both classes are reported
